```sql
WITH
iade_sip AS (
    -- Her sipariş kalemi için iade edilen adet
    SELECT
        sk.urun_id,
        sk.siparis_id,
        sk.adet AS satilan_adet,
        sk.birim_fiyat,
        COALESCE(iad.toplam_iade, 0) AS iade_adet
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT siparis_id, urun_id, SUM(adet) AS toplam_iade
        FROM iadeler
        GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
    ) iad ON iad.siparis_id = sk.siparis_id AND iad.urun_id = sk.urun_id
)
SELECT
    u.ad AS urun_adi,
    (SELECT SUM(sk.adet) FROM siparis_kalemleri sk WHERE sk.urun_id = u.id)
    - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.adet), 0) FROM iadeler i WHERE i.urun_id = u.id)
        AS net_adet,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN i.sk_adet - i.iade_adet > 0
        THEN (i.sk_adet - i.iade_adet) * i.birim_fiyat
        ELSE 0 END
    ), 0), 2) AS net_ciro
FROM urunler u
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        urun_id,
        satilan_adet AS sk_adet,
        iade_adet,
        birim_fiyat
    FROM iade_sip
) i ON i.urun_id = u.id
GROUP BY u.id, u.ad
ORDER BY net_ciro DESC, urun_adi ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

)
SELECT
    u.ad AS urun_adi,
    (SELECT SUM(sk.adet) FROM siparis_kalemleri sk WHERE sk.urun_id = u.id)
    - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.adet), 0) FROM iadeler i WHERE i.urun_id = u.id)
        AS net_adet,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN i.sk_adet - i.iade_adet > 0
        THEN (i.sk_adet - i.iade_adet) * i.birim_fiyat
        ELSE 0 END

    SELECT

        satilan_adet AS sk_adet,
        iade_adet,
